messages:
liam: FYI prod-eu embeddings started returning intermittent 502s for short inputs around 09:05 UTC. Error rate climbed to ~7.5% on customer traffic. I can reproduce by hitting short seq path. Suspect recent attn micro-optim.

deploybot: :robot_face: Deploy request template available. Suggested action: roll image or apply hotfix image. Run `/deploy start embeddings --image rwd/embeds:v2.1.3-hotfix --canary 0.1 --reason "502 on short seq"` to initiate.

liam: Patch is tiny: add guard in kv-cache ctor and fallback to slower kernel for seq<8. Locally rollback to previous image removes errors. Proposed rollback thresholds: error_rate > 3% sustained over 120s OR p95_latency > 2s.

marta: I'm release lead. Can someone on infra on-call sign off for expedited? This is customer-facing in EU.

sachin: on-call infra here. I'll approve expedited with telemetry auto-rollback. Need incident hook to page if thresholds hit.

ops-bot: @sachin Hook configured: post alerts to #incidents + page on-call. Thresholds set: error_rate > 3% over 120s OR p95 > 2s. Auto-rollback enabled: true.

emily: did quick smoke on eu-staging with hotfix image; short and long paths okay. No perf regression in our perf job. LGTM from QA.

marta: can we shorten canary? customers impacted. Proposal: 10% for 3m, 50% for 6m, then manual to 100% unless alarms. Faster than normal but still staged. Approve from me if infra signs.

sachin: approve. I'll watch the pager during rollout. :white_check_mark:

liam: kicking off deploy: `/deploy start embeddings --image rwd/embeds:v2.1.3-hotfix --canary 0.1 --steps "3m@10%,6m@50%,manual@100%" --reason "502 on short seq"`

deploybot: :rocket: Deploy started by liam. Stage 1 (10%) job id: db-1751120123-01. Logs: ```[09:12:20] pulling rwd/embeds:v2.1.3-hotfix
[09:12:31] creating pods
[09:12:55] liveness & readiness passing```

liam: watching metrics 1: error rate in canary at 0.8%, p95 stable. Canary traffic healthy.

sachin: still monitoring. Pager armed. Ops will auto-rollback if thresholds crossed.

deploybot: Stage 1 complete. Promoting to 50% (stage 2). Job id: db-1751120123-02.

liam: 50% healthy after ~4m. No sign of regression. Error rate dropped to baseline in eu.

marta: good. Please hold until stage completes then manual promote to 100%. I'll be available for handover.

deploybot: Stage 2 complete. Waiting manual approval for 100% (manual@100%).

liam: manual promote: `/deploy promote db-1751120123-02 --to 100`

deploybot: :tada: Promoted to 100% across prod. Final job id: db-1751120123-03. Health checks green.

ops-bot: Snapshot after full rollout: eu error rate back to baseline 0.1%, p95 unchanged. No auto-rollback triggered.

sachin: marking incident mitigated. Continuing observation window for 2 hours.

emily: release PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/pull/1830 (draft). Added changelog: "embeddings: fix 502 for short sequences (v2.1.3-hotfix)". No CVE implications.

releasebot: Linked release PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/pull/1830. Draft note created.

marta: retrospective note: add a unit/integration test for seq<8 path to prevent regressions. Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/412. Also consider a stress job for short-seq traffic in PR gating.

liam: thanks for quick approvals and QA. Closing thread; will re-open if any flare-ups. :eyes:
